tasks.title: Project scaffold
tasks.desc: Create `index.html`, `style.css` and `src/main.js` (ES modules, no build step). Page loads with a blank `<canvas>`.

tasks.title: Dev server and lint
tasks.desc: Document `python -m http.server` in the README; add a minimal ESLint config.

tasks.title: Board model
tasks.desc: 10x20 grid as a typed array, with `get`, `set`, `isInside` and `clone`. Unit-testable without the DOM.

tasks.title: Tetromino definitions
tasks.desc: The seven pieces (I, O, T, S, Z, J, L) with their four rotation states and colors.

tasks.title: Collision detection
tasks.desc: `collides(board, piece, x, y, rotation)` covering walls, floor and settled blocks.

tasks.title: SRS rotation with wall kicks
tasks.desc: Super Rotation System kick tables for JLSTZ and I pieces.

tasks.title: Line clearing
tasks.desc: Detect full rows, remove them and shift the rows above down. Return the number of cleared lines.

tasks.title: 7-bag randomizer
tasks.desc: Shuffle all seven pieces into a bag and deal from it, refilling when empty.

tasks.title: Game loop and gravity
tasks.desc: `requestAnimationFrame` loop with a fixed-step gravity timer; lock delay of 500 ms.

tasks.title: Keyboard controls
tasks.desc: Left/right with DAS and ARR, soft drop, hard drop, rotate CW/CCW, hold.

tasks.title: Hold piece
tasks.desc: Swap the active piece into the hold slot, once per drop.

tasks.title: Scoring and levels
tasks.desc: Guideline scoring (single to tetris, soft/hard drop points). Level up every 10 lines; gravity speeds up.

tasks.title: Game over and restart
tasks.desc: Top-out detection when a new piece spawns colliding; overlay with a restart button.

tasks.title: Board renderer
tasks.desc: Draw settled blocks and the active piece on the canvas, scaled to the window.

tasks.title: Ghost piece
tasks.desc: Translucent preview of where the active piece will land.

tasks.title: Next queue and hold panel
tasks.desc: Side panels showing the next five pieces and the held piece.

tasks.title: HUD: score, level, lines
tasks.desc: Text panel updated each frame from the game state.

tasks.title: Sound effects
tasks.desc: Web Audio beeps for move, rotate, lock, line clear and tetris. Mute toggle.

tasks.title: High score persistence
tasks.desc: Store the top 10 scores in `localStorage`; show them on the game-over overlay.

tasks.title: Mobile touch controls
tasks.desc: Swipe to move and drop, tap to rotate. Optional; decide after playtesting.

tasks.title: Piece lock and line clear integration
